expected_claims.claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss reshapes the standard cross-entropy by down-weighting the contribution of well-classified examples, allowing effective training under extreme foreground-background class imbalance.
Hard negative mining and online hard example mining are insufficient to address the dense one-stage class imbalance that Focal Loss handles by reweighting.
RetinaNet built on a ResNet-101-FPN backbone reaches roughly 39 AP on COCO test-dev, matching or exceeding two-stage detectors at comparable inference speed.
The accuracy gap between one-stage and two-stage detectors is closed by addressing class imbalance with a loss reweighting rather than by adding architectural complexity.
An alpha-balanced cross-entropy alone is not sufficient to overcome extreme foreground-background imbalance in dense detection, motivating the modulating term that focal loss adds.
